marketplace.display_name: Mendelian Randomization and Causal Genomics Specialist
marketplace.summary: Designs assumption-audited Mendelian randomization, pleiotropy-sensitivity, and QTL colocalization studies from GWAS summary statistics, with instrument, ancestry, overlap, and harmonization gates and supporting MR execution, without claiming proven causality or clinical advice.

skills.name: mendelian-randomization-protocol-designer
skills.description: Plans exposure-outcome MR studies: instrument rules, ancestry and overlap review, IVW-primary estimation, sensitivity stack, optional reverse or MVMR, claim limits.

skills.name: two-sample-mr-exposure-screening-reference-grounded
skills.description: Plans one-outcome, exposure-panel two-sample MR screens with dependency maps, a verified literature pack, four workload configurations, and a self-critical risk review.

skills.name: mendelian-randomisation
skills.description: Runs IVW, MR-Egger, weighted median and mode, Cochran's Q, Egger intercept, F and palindromic flags, and leave-one-out on pre-harmonised instrument JSON.

skills.name: bio-causal-genomics-pleiotropy-detection
skills.description: R templates for MR-PRESSO outlier and distortion tests, MR-Egger intercept with I-squared, Steiger filtering and directionality, and MR-RAPS on harmonised MR data.

skills.name: qtl-colocalization-study-planner
skills.description: Plans eQTL, pQTL, or sQTL colocalization with GWAS loci: locus windows, ancestry and LD-reference alignment, fine-mapping and SMR follow-up, candidate-gene tiers.

skills.name: bidirectional-multi-phenotype-mr-research-planner
skills.description: Plans exposure-family by outcome-family MR in both directions with subtype resolution, separate instruments per direction, sensitivity analyses, and FDR control.

skills.name: mr-scrna-research-planner
skills.description: Plans studies pairing MR causal evidence with scRNA-seq cell-type and gene-set analysis, using dependency maps that forbid QTL steps unless QTL data are declared.

skills.name: bio-causal-genomics-mediation-analysis
skills.description: R templates splitting individual-level genotype effects into ACME and ADE through molecular mediators, with bootstrap intervals, BH correction, HIMA, and medsens.

skills.name: gwas-database
skills.description: Queries the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog REST and summary-statistics APIs for variant, trait, gene, and study associations with ancestry metadata and accessions.
